submission.justification:
Selection-S2 at 60% signal efficiency achieves the highest expected significance (3.518σ) among all viable configurations while satisfying all constraints.

STRATEGY SELECTION: Selection-S2 (neural-network classifier on kinematic variables only) was chosen because:
• Selection-S3 is DISQUALIFIED due to 35% data/MC disagreement, which far exceeds the hard 10% limit due to poorly modelled jet substructure variables
• Selection-S2 outperforms Selection-S1 at every tested working point by 0.52-0.97σ
• S2 provides superior signal/background discrimination using well-modelled kinematic inputs

WORKING POINT OPTIMIZATION: The 60% efficiency point was identified through systematic scanning of 14 configurations (7 working points × 2 viable strategies):
• S2 @ 60% efficiency achieves the global maximum significance of 3.518σ
• This represents a 0.938σ (36%) improvement over the best alternative (S1 @ 40% efficiency: 2.580σ)
• The peak is well-defined and stable, not at boundary conditions

CONSTRAINT COMPLIANCE: All requirements are satisfied:
• Data/MC validation: 6% disagreement is well within the 10% hard limit, leaving substantial margin
• Signal efficiency: 60% is within the required 20-80% range
• Uses approved selection strategy from candidate specifications

ROBUSTNESS: S2 demonstrates consistent performance across the efficiency range, maintaining >2.86σ even at suboptimal points, indicating a robust selection with reliable background modeling.
